topic: Asking レン out for the 24th
title_jp: {勇気|ゆうき}を{出した|だした}{日|ひ}
text_title: 12{月|がつ}19{日|にち}（{土|ど}）の{日記|にっき|diary|3}
context: Saturday 19 December: after shovelling snow with {健太|けんた} in the morning, アルちゃん finally asks レン himself to see a film on the 24th. レン says yes: his cinema is showing an old Christmas classic. アルちゃん writes it all in his diary that night.
scene: Saturday night. You open your diary: snow shovelling, a nervous message to レン, and the answer you waited all afternoon for.

phrases.jp: {時間|じかん}さえあれば、{映画|えいが}を{見て|みて}いる。
phrases.en: Whenever I have time, I'm watching films.
phrases.note: 〜さえあれば = as long as I have …: shows a real passion.

phrases.jp: {返事|へんじ}が{来る|くる}まで、{そわそわ||restless, fidgety|3}しちゃう。
phrases.en: I get all fidgety until the reply comes.
phrases.note: そわそわする: can't sit still, checking your phone.

phrases.jp: {返事|へんじ}が{来て|きて}、{ほっと||relieved|4}した。
phrases.en: I was relieved when the reply came.
phrases.note: ほっとする = a weight off your shoulders.

phrases.jp: {楽しみ|たのしみ}で{仕方がない|しかたがない|can't help it, unbearably|3}。
phrases.en: I'm so looking forward to it I can't stand it.

phrases.jp: {趣味|しゅみ}が{同じ|おなじ}だと、{話が合う|はなしがあう|to get on, click|3}よね。
phrases.en: When you share a hobby, you really click.
phrases.note: {話|はなし}が{合|あ}う = you have lots to talk about.

dialogue_setting: Your room above the {田中|たなか} house, late at night, under the kotatsu. A paper diary.

dialogue.speaker: Morning
dialogue.jp: {朝|あさ}、{健太|けんた}と{雪かき|ゆきかき|snow shovelling|3}をした。{腰|こし|lower back|3}が{痛い|いたい}けど、{気持ち|きもち}いい。
dialogue.en: In the morning I shovelled snow with {健太|けんた}. My back hurts, but it felt good.

dialogue.speaker: Lunch break
dialogue.jp: {休憩|きゅうけい|break, rest|3}{中|ちゅう}、{勇気|ゆうき|courage|3}を{出して|だして}レンを{誘った|さそった}。「24{日|か}、{一緒|いっしょ}に{映画|えいが}{見ない|みない}？」
dialogue.en: On my break I plucked up the courage and asked レン: 'Want to see a film together on the 24th?'

dialogue.speaker: Afternoon
dialogue.jp: {返事|へんじ}が{来る|くる}まで、ずっと{そわそわ||restless, fidgety|3}。{仕事|しごと}に{全然|ぜんぜん}{集中|しゅうちゅう|concentration|3}できなかった。
dialogue.en: Until the reply came I was on edge the whole time. I couldn't concentrate on work at all.

dialogue.speaker: Evening
dialogue.jp: 5{時|じ}ごろ、やっと{返事|へんじ}。「いいね。『{素晴|すば}らしき{哉|かな}、{人生|じんせい}！』をやるよ」。{ほっと||relieved|4}した。
dialogue.en: Around five, finally, a reply: 'Sounds good. They're showing It's a Wonderful Life.' What a relief.

dialogue.speaker: Night
dialogue.jp: {雪|ゆき}さえ{降らなければ|ふらなければ}、{電車|でんしゃ}は{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}。{天気|てんき}さえよければ、{最高|さいこう}のイブになるはず。
dialogue.en: As long as it doesn't snow, the trains will be fine. As long as the weather's good, it'll be the best Christmas Eve.

dialogue.speaker: Night
dialogue.jp: {嬉しくて|うれしくて|happy, glad|4}{眠れない|ねむれない|to sleep|4}。{由紀|ゆき}に{報告|ほうこく|report|3}して、{作戦|さくせん|plan, strategy|3}を{立てよう|たてよう}。
dialogue.en: I'm too happy to sleep. I'll report to {由紀|ゆき} and work out a plan.

listening.intro: While you were in the bath, レン called and left a message.

lines.jp: アルちゃん、レンです。お{風呂|ふろ}かな？24{日|か}は、5{時半|じはん}に{映画館|えいがかん}の{前|まえ}で{待ってる|まってる}ね。
lines.en: アルちゃん, it's レン. In the bath? On the 24th I'll wait for you in front of the cinema at half past five.

lines.jp: {夜|よる}は{冷える|ひえる|to get cold|3}から、{暖かく|あたたかく}して{来て|きて}ね。
lines.en: It gets cold at night, so wrap up warm.

listening.question: 24{日|か}は、{何時|なんじ}にどこで{会いますか|あいますか}。
listening.explain: 5{時半|じはん}に{映画館|えいがかん}の{前|まえ}で: half past five, in front of the cinema.

grammar.form: noun + さえ + ば-form ({雪|ゆき}さえ{降|ふ}らなければ, {天気|てんき}さえよければ, {時間|じかん}さえあれば) · verb stem + さえすれば ({練習|れんしゅう}しさえすれば, {飲|の}みさえすれば) · て-form + さえいれば ({寝|ね}てさえいれば)
grammar.explanation: 'As long as X': X is the only condition you need, and everything else will be fine. Very often 〜さえあれば or 〜さえよければ. Unlike a plain 〜ば, it stresses that nothing else matters. Alone, さえ means 'even'.

examples.jp: {颯太|そうた}は、ゲームさえあれば{何|なに}もいらない。
examples.en: As long as {颯太|そうた} has his games, he needs nothing else.

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}は、お{好み焼き|このみやき|okonomiyaki|4}さえあれば{幸せ|しあわせ}だ。
examples.en: {健太|けんた} is happy as long as there's okonomiyaki.

quiz.question: お{金|かね}＿＿あれば、{旅行|りょこう}に{行ける|いける}のに。
quiz.en: If only I had the money, I could go travelling.
quiz.explain: Noun + さえ + ば: money is the only thing missing.

quiz_more.question: この{薬|くすり}を{飲み|のみ}＿＿すれば、すぐ{治ります|なおります}よ。
quiz_more.en: As long as you take this medicine, you'll soon get better.
quiz_more.explain: Verb stem + さえすれば = as long as you just do it.

quiz_more.question: {雪|ゆき}さえ＿＿、{電車|でんしゃ}は{止まらない|とまらない}。
quiz_more.en: As long as it doesn't snow, the trains won't stop.
quiz_more.explain: さえ needs a ば-form after it: {降|ふ}らなければ.

kanji.where: On the cinema's schedule page レン sends with his reply: 「{上映|じょうえい}{時間|じかん} 18:00」.
kanji.breakdown: 上 up + 映 project, reflect → putting the picture up on the screen.
kanji.related: {上映中|じょうえいちゅう} = now showing. {映画|えいが} = film.

tip.title: Three heartbeats
tip.body: ドキドキ is a pounding heart, from nerves or love. わくわく is happy excitement before something fun. そわそわ is restless: you can't sit still and keep checking your phone.

challenge.prompt: {由紀|ゆき} on LINE: 「で、レン{誘えた|さそえた}の？？」 Tell her you did, and that as long as it doesn't snow, you're seeing a film on the 24th.
challenge.model_answer: {誘えた|さそえた}よ！{雪|ゆき}さえ{降らなければ|ふらなければ}、24{日|か}に{映画|えいが}を{見に行く|みにいく}よ。
challenge.explanation: {誘|さそ}えた is the potential past: 'I managed to ask him'. {雪|ゆき}さえ{降|ふ}らなければ sets the only condition: as long as it doesn't snow. With {由紀|ゆき} plain form and よ keep it casual.

vocab.note: {腰|こし}が{痛|いた}い = lower back pain, very common after snow shovelling.
{休憩中|きゅうけいちゅう} = on a break. Sign on shop doors too.
そわそわする. Nervous waiting, often before something good.
〜に{集中|しゅうちゅう}する. {集|あつ}める gather + {中|なか} centre.
ほっとする. Like a sigh of relief: ほっ.
For your own feelings. For others: {嬉|うれ}しそう.
{眠|ねむ}れない = can't get to sleep. {寝|ね}る = go to bed.
Work word, used jokingly with friends: {報告|ほうこく}します！
Alone: it can't be helped. After 〜て: unbearably.
Lots to talk about, same wavelength.

kanji_study.parts: 目 eye + 民 people → the eyes of all the people closed at night: sleep.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 眼 (eye): 眼 has 艮 on the right, 眠 has 民 people.

kanji_study.parts: 単 a simple forked weapon + 戈 halberd → weapons clashing: battle.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 我 (I, self): 我 has no 単 on the left.

extras.title: Inviting, softly
extras.title_jp: やわらかく{誘う|さそう}
extras.intro: Negative questions make an invitation easy to refuse, which makes it easier to say.

items.jp: {一緒|いっしょ}に{映画|えいが}{見ない|みない}？
items.en: Want to watch a film together?

items.jp: よかったら、{今度|こんど}ご{飯|はん}でもどう？
items.en: If you like, how about dinner sometime?

items.jp: {無理|むり}だったら、{全然|ぜんぜん}{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}だから。
items.en: If you can't, that's totally fine.
items.note: Leaves the other person a way out.

extras.title: Film words
extras.intro: For your night at レン's cinema.

items.note: Old foreign films are usually {字幕|じまく}, not dubbed.
